title: Transform worker role

user_story.i_want: the worker's transform role to consume transform messages and load them

description: `TransformHandler` implements MessageHandler: parse the TransformMessage, stream the staged file (reuse the decoder, made generic over `T: DeserializeOwned`), transform (STR-502), and load (STR-503). Track parts per file (an `ingest_file_parts` table, or expected/loaded counts on the ledger). The file becomes `loaded` once every data_type part is loaded. The worker binary takes `--role classify|transform|all`.

acceptance_criteria.then: rows land in the right table and the ledger becomes loaded once all parts are done
no duplicate rows and unchanged ledger counts
it returns Retry, and succeeds after Postgres comes back
both consumers run in one process with independent concurrency settings
